refresh.name: Refresh departures now
refresh.description: Immediately polls Transit App for the freshest departures, bypassing any configured quiet hours/days and presence filter. Useful for on-demand debugging without waiting for the next scheduled poll or changing your quota-saving settings.

config_entry_id.description: Which Transit App config entry to refresh. Refreshes all of them if omitted.
